card.name: "the" after increasing in CYP interaction advice
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "increasing" or "adjust" in drug-interaction advice about CYP3A4 or CYP2D6 inhibitors or inducers, just before a drug name. Also the word "increasing" or "increased" itself in this setting.

modes.label: "the" before drug name
modes.description: The word "the" after "consider increasing" or "adjust" when a CYP inhibitor or inducer is stopped or started, with a drug name next.
modes.example: If a CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing<< the>> Codeine Sulfate Tablets dosage until

modes.label: increase wording
modes.description: The word "increasing" or "increased" itself, in CYP interaction statements.
modes.example: Coadministration with CYP3A inhibitors (moderate and strong) results in<< increased>> systemic exposure to amlodipine

card.writes: The promoted tokens are scattered Chinese characters, so there is no clear output effect on English text.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word "the" in advice to increase a drug's dose when an interacting drug is changed.
